watches.notes: Home from Morzine after Spartan Ultra World Champs (Jul 3, 50k — race Sat, recover Sun, fly Mon). Fares live since ~8/8/26. 10/19/26: MAIN $552 (Basic $461; $351 of it tax), GVA–LHR–DFW 2h connect, BA metal into LHR. Miles break-even at 2.0 cpp = ~27,500 — but BA-metal awards carry heavy surcharges and every $1 of surcharge cuts the break-even, e.g. $250 surcharge -> ~15,000 miles. Open-jaw ruled out 10/19 (multi-city $1,653 vs $1,391 as two one-ways). Book separately; pay CASH on this leg unless an AA-metal routing with low surcharges appears. Trip plan: Eurostar London→Lille Jun 29, TGV to Reims, car pickup Reims (verify Avis GVA one-way drop; CDG fallback), Champagne/Burgundy→Jura→Annecy drive, Morzine Fri Jul 2, drop car GVA French sector.

Swiss Alps 100. 10/19/26 aa.com: MAIN $1,252 — the authoritative number. Expedia showed $770 'Basic' and a $890 Main estimate; BOTH WRONG by ~$362. Third failure of Expedia international pricing (cf. YYZ $517 vs $664). DO NOT extrapolate Main from Expedia on these routes — screen only, confirm on aa.com. The original $1,300 placeholder was within 4% and should not have been reset to $690. Target now $1,130 (~90% of the verified aa.com Main). Wed Aug 11 return. Expedia showed price parity with the Aug 14 row and a worse routing, but that comparison is unverified — re-check both dates on aa.com. | PERSONAL TRIP — points preferred, but 10/19/26 award = 138,500 miles vs $1,252 cash = 0.90 cpp, and ~0.75 cpp after likely BA surcharges. Far below the 2.0 line: PAY CASH. 138.5k at 2.0 cpp is ~$2,770 of value elsewhere, so redeeming here destroys ~$1,500. 138.5k = AA dynamic pricing with NO saver space open, not the trip's true mileage cost. AWARD TRIGGER: take the award only if saver opens at <= ~62,600 miles (or ~50,000 after a $250 surcharge). Watch award space alongside cash — peak-August Europe saver does open in waves.

One way to WTM 2027. 10/19/26: AA 20 nonstop 6:15p — MAIN $839 (Basic $719; $419 tax). OPEN-JAW RESOLVED: DFW→LHR / GVA→DFW as one multi-city ticket prices $1,653 — WORSE than two separate one-ways ($1,391) by $262. Transatlantic one-ways now price at true half-round-trip, and an open-jaw across two markets (US–UK / CH–US) forces combinable higher buckets. DECISION: book as two separate one-ways; legs are 13 days apart so there is no connection to protect, and each ticket stays independently repriceable. REMAINING LEVER: award on this leg — AA metal, so under ~41,500 miles take the award and cash outlay for the trip drops to ~$552.

NOT a flight — booking reminder, no fare search. Eurostar London→Lille + TGV Lille→Reims; car pickup Reims (or CDG fallback). 10/19 check: Eurostar inventory currently extends only to 17 Mar 2027, so 29 Jun 2027 is NOT yet bookable — the old ~Oct 2026 estimate was too early. Horizon is ~360 days but actual release lags, and Eurostar's cheapest fares typically surface 4–5 months out, i.e. Feb–Mar 2027. Window start moved to 1/15/27 to catch the release.
